The reading order in the output perfectly reflects the logical flow of the source document, moving from headers to the explanatory paragraph and then to the specific rule filings.
The source document does not contain explicit bulleted or numbered lists. The list-like entries at the end of the page are correctly processed as sequential paragraphs.
There are no links in the source document, and none have been fabricated in the output.
